name: Maneda Design Studios
urlNote: Confirmed by Manolo: manedastudios.com is his, newly purchased, nothing hosted on it yet. Main address is the version without www.

serviceArea.en: Orlando and Central Florida. Projects across the United States.
serviceArea.pt: Orlando e Flórida Central. Projetos em todos os Estados Unidos.

social._help: Profile links for the footer and for Google's structured data (sameAs). Replace each [ADD ...] with the full https address. Anything still in [brackets] is left out of the site automatically.

_showPricesHelp: false hides every dollar amount on the site (home, services, structured data) and shows "shared after a conversation" instead. The amounts stay in pricing.json.
indexingNote: Keep false until launch. While false, every page is marked noindex and robots.txt blocks crawlers.

ads._help: Google Ads. Paste the tag id (AW-...) and the label of the Contact form conversion, then set enabled to true. While enabled, the Google tag loads, a conversion is reported on the thank-you page, the ad click id and campaign tags ride along with each inquiry, and the privacy page switches to the Google Ads wording.

featuresNote: Set to true only when real content exists. While false, those pages are left out of the build and the sitemap, and their links disappear.
privacyUpdatedNote: Change this date whenever the privacy policy text changes, and on launch day.
legalReviewNote: Set to true after a lawyer has reviewed the privacy policy and your standard agreement. See LEGAL-CHECKLIST.md.
showPlaceholdersNote: true shows gray frames where images will go (preview). Set to false at launch: every empty image slot then disappears and the site is also hidden from search while it is true.

booking._help: Paste the address of your scheduling page (for example a Cal.com link) in "url" to show a "Book a scoping call" button on the home and contact pages. Leave it empty to hide the button.
